text:
maya: Quick ask — can we make a 1-page field flashcard for AMs? Core: enterprise security, SLA snapshot, and deploy-mode cheatline (hosted/dedicated/private). Need scannable for live demos.

sam: Yep. Keep it punchy: 3 quick bullets for security, 3 for SLA/benchmarks, 1-line deploy decision flow.

olivia: Sales will ask numbers — can we include typical p95 numbers for hosted vs dedicated and a tiny "benchmarks" back panel? Mark as "typical, workload dependent".

leo: Draft bullets: 
- Security: SOC2 Type II, VPC/private control plane option, KMS/HSM, exportable audit logs.
- SLA: Hosted = published SLOs (best-effort), Dedicated = 99.9% uptime + configurable latency SLOs, Private = contract SLA.
- Deploy guidance: Hosted = fastest TT V; Dedicated = predictable throughput & isolation; Private = on-prem/residency/regulatory.

sam: Add routing note: self-serve for small deals (< $100k ARR or <1M tokens/mo); sales-assisted for enterprise security/regulatory or >1M tokens/mo.

maya: Front of card should be 6 lines max for AMs to read in demo. Backside tiny table: workload / p95 hosted / p95 dedicated / note — three rows: small gen, long-chat, embeddings batch.

olivia: I'll draft the numbers: small gen p95 — Hosted: ~100–200ms, Dedicated: ~70–120ms; long-chat depends on context window and batching; embeddings batch latency varies by batch size, give ballpark. Will flag anything needing infra signoff.

leo: Add upsell line: compliance add-ons like extended log retention & custom audit exports. Also CTAs: "Start free hosted trial" and "Request Dedicated eval".

sam: I'll format routing rules and two CTAs, then ping design.

launch-bot: Template: https://internal.assets/redwood/marketing/field-flashcard-template_v2.sketch — use 3:2 portrait, primary CTA slots, include legal footnote area.

maya: Perfect. @sam @olivia please review copy ASAP. Goal: hand to design by tomorrow noon PST for webinar-ready asset by EOW. :rocket:
